item.text: I’ll first look at the existing project structure, then I’ll build the simplest version that fits it: a book list, an add form, a finished action, and shareable book detail links backed by a JSON file.

There’s no application code or framework in the workspace yet. I’m setting this up as a small Node app using built-in modules, with an atomic JSON-file write so concurrent updates won’t leave a half-written library.

The main flow is in place, including a detail page at `/books/<id>` that works as a direct link and a copy-link button. I’ve also added an empty `data/books.json` so the storage file is present from the start; I’m checking the changed files now.

item.text:
Built a small reading tracker with a form to add books, separate “Currently reading” and “Finished” shelves, and an action to mark a book finished. Each book has a detail page showing its title, author, and notes, with a button to copy its link.

Books are stored in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json) and persist across restarts. Start the app with `npm start`, then open `http://localhost:3000`.

A copied link points to a single book’s detail page. For someone else to open it, the app needs to be running at an address they can reach; `localhost` works only on your own machine. I didn’t run tests.
